narr: Thunderstorms brought locally heavy rain to Camden County on the afternoon of September 9. Rainfall totals were as high as 2.5 to 3.5 inches.
ev: Flooding occurred along Interstate 295 in the Bellmawr and Haddon Heights area from Interchange 28 to Interchange 29. The southbound lanes were covered with up to a foot or two of water.
lsr: NWS employee reports flash flooding on I-295 at exit 28 with 1-2 feet of water covering the southbound roadway. Flooding at exit 29 as well.
